'''Skyscan 6''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]].<ref name="Unknown">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Located in geosynchronous orbit directly above the city of [[Eeookko]], Skyscan 6 was a small space station was one of several stations that operated as part of the Skyscan early warning system, set up to detect [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorites]] and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] that threaten the planet's surface. Skyscan 6 was directly operated by [[Eeook Corporation]], and was manned by thirty individuals who kept a constant vigil both the sky as well as [[Eeookko]]'s neighbors.<ref name="Unknown" /> The station was lightly armed for defense against [[pirate]]s, but also carried heavy [[missile]]s for destroying or altering the course of incoming asteroids.<ref name="Unknown" />
